title: Koftas - nice ones
preamble:
To include bell peppers, we can make a delicious Turkish-style Adana Kofta.
This version uses finely minced red bell pepper directly in the meat mixture, which adds incredible sweetness, moisture, and color.
Ingredients:-
500g
minced meat (lamb or a beef-lamb mix)
1
red bell pepper (finely minced, liquid squeezed out)
1
small onion (grated, liquid squeezed out)
2
garlic cloves (finely minced)
1
tbsp tomato purée
1
tsp red pepper flakes (or Aleppo pepper)
1
tsp ground cumin
1
tsp salt
½
tsp black pepperInstructions

To include bell peppers, we can make a delicious Turkish-style Adana Kofta.

This version uses finely minced red bell pepper directly in the meat mixture, which adds incredible sweetness, moisture, and color.

500g
minced meat (lamb or a beef-lamb mix)
1
red bell pepper (finely minced, liquid squeezed out)
1
small onion (grated, liquid squeezed out)
2
garlic cloves (finely minced)
1
tbsp tomato purée
1
tsp red pepper flakes (or Aleppo pepper)
1
tsp ground cumin
1
tsp salt
½
tsp black pepperInstructions

Method:-
Prep vegetables:
Finely mince the red bell pepper and grate the onion.
Place them in a clean tea towel and squeeze out all excess liquid. This prevents the meat from falling off the skewers.
Mix:
Combine the squeezed vegetables, meat, garlic, tomato purée, and spices in a bowl.
Knead the mixture with your hands for 5 minutes until it becomes sticky and paste-like.
Shape:
Press the meat firmly onto wide metal or soaked wooden skewers into flat, elongated kebab shapes.
Chill:
Place the skewers in the fridge for 30 minutes to firm up.
Cook:
Grill on a hot barbecue or griddle pan for 3–4 minutes per side until charred and cooked through
